Report on Awareness Program on General Health and CPR Training 

As a part of the * *Student Induction Program 2025-26**, an **Awareness Program on General Health and CPR Training* * was organized for the engineering students one 17th October 2025 in the College; Auditorium.

The awareness session was conducted by Dr.Santhosh, DRM Hospital, Mysuru. The objective of the program was to create awareness among students about maintaining good physical and mental health and to equip them with basic life-saving skills. Dr. Santhosh highlighted the importance of regular exercise, balanced diet, stress management, and preventive healthcare. He also demonstrated **Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR)** techniques, explaining how timely first aid can save lives during medical emergencies.
